messages:
Maya: Quick sync 1 proposing a spike safety-net for customers who bust their commits. Options: short overage credits, soft throttles, and priority routing to Dedicated (if purchased). Need launch gating and abuse rules. @Sam @David @Leah
Sam: Credit-first preferred. Small pre-funded pool that auto-applies for 24h, then either bill or throttle. Keep UX minimal for finance.
David: Agree but add hard caps and consecutive-day limits to avoid runaway costs.
Leah: Telemetry concern 1 can we reliably tell spike vs growth? Need detection rules and FP budget.
product-bot: Draft policy snippet:
`overage_guardrail: grace_hours:24 credit_pct_of_commit:5 throttle_threshold_pct:200 throttle_mode:soft ramp_minutes:30 escalation:[notify_customer,notify_ops]`
Anna: Finance needs refund rules and GL mapping if credits are pre-billed.
Sam: Pilot with 3 customers across segments for 6 weeks. Manual review for auto-applied credits in pilot.
David: Throttles must not break latency SLAs. Prefer queue-admission throttles. Ops to simulate.
Leah: Console UX: banner + one-click actions: Apply credit / Start throttle / Escalate. Ops & AE override.
Maya: Launch criteria draft: telemetry >95% for pilot customers; pilot run with <=2 manual escalations per customer; legal + finance signoff. Opt-in soft launch after.
Anna: Rollout tiers: Pilot (manual), Early access (auto credits capped at 5% commit), GA (auto credits + purchasable overage SKUs).
Sam: Consider a signed entitlement header for priority routing to Dedicated to prevent spoofing.
Leah: Ill build a small eval harness to measure FPR; target <1% for pilot.
Maya: Action items: Sam: credit UX + pilot flow by EOD Fri. David+Ops: throttle sims by Tue. Leah: detection rules & Console flows by Thu. Anna: SKU & accounting draft. Legal: start T&C review.
Sam: I'll prototype the banner and Apply credit modal.
Maya: Thanks all, reconvene after sims. :thumbsup:
